تخترقون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِقُونَ (taḵtariqūna) /tax.ta.ri.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# تُخْتَرَقُونَ (tuḵtaraqūna) /tux.ta.ra.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
